Abres tu proyecto en el editor de PCB y: Open your project in the PCB editor and press the **KiCad IA** button. The chat opens in your browser and works with the KiCad you have open.
Mientras el chat escribe el esquemático,: While the chat writes the schematic, keep the schematic editor closed. When it's done, press **F8** in KiCad to bring the changes to the board.
Te pregunta lo que falta en lugar de dec: It asks about anything missing instead of deciding for you.
Cada componente lleva una huella de tus: Every component gets a footprint from your libraries.
Ves la propuesta de colocación antes de: You see the placement proposal before it's applied.
El autoruteo solo aparece si lo activas: Autorouting only shows up if you turn it on in Settings.
Un ejemplo real: un LED alimentado por U: A real example: an LED powered over USB-C, from the button in KiCad to the routed board. Follow it step by step or watch the video.
En el editor de PCB, pulsa el botón **Ki: In the PCB editor, press the **KiCad IA** toolbar button. The plugin starts on your computer.
El chat se abre en tu navegador. Arriba: The chat opens in your browser. At the top you can see whether KiCad is connected, which model you're using, and how many tokens you've used. On the left, your project and its libraries.
Escríbelo con tus palabras. El chat enti: Describe it in your own words. The chat works out what you need and looks for each part in your libraries. You can see what it's doing at every moment.
La resistencia y el LED no traen huella,: The resistor and the LED have no footprint, so it offers you the options in your libraries. It also suggests 5.1 kΩ resistors on CC1 and CC2, then waits for your answer.
Con tu respuesta escribe el esquemático,: With your answer, it writes the schematic, saves a backup, and checks for electrical errors (ERC). Remember that the schematic editor must be closed.
En KiCad, ve a **Herramientas › Actualiz: In KiCad, go to **Tools › Update PCB from Schematic** (F8). You do this step yourself. The footprints appear next to the board outline.
Calcula dónde va cada componente, lo rev: It works out where each component goes, checks it against IPC Class 2 criteria, and shows you the proposal without touching the board. If you set up a reviewer model, it takes a second look. It's applied when you confirm.
FreeRouting traza las pistas sobre una c: FreeRouting draws the tracks on a copy of your board. Then the plugin checks the design rules (DRC) and shows you the result before applying it.
Al confirmar, las pistas pasan a la plac: Once you confirm, the tracks go to the board you have open in KiCad. If you like, ask for a 3D view to check it.
Listo: la placa queda colocada y ruteada: Done: the board is placed and routed. Check it, save it, and move on to manufacturing.
Lo haces una sola vez: eliges el modelo,: You only do this once: choose the model, paste your key, and turn on autorouting if you want it. Everything stays saved on your computer.
La primera vez, el indicador del modelo: The first time, the model indicator is red: you can check the status, but you can't design yet. Open Settings with the gear icon.
Escoge Google Gemini, Ollama en tu equip: Choose Google Gemini, Ollama on your computer, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible service. The service address fills in automatically.
La clave se guarda solo en tu equipo, nu: The key is stored only on your computer, never in the repository. If you use Ollama, you can leave it empty.
El modelo principal conversa contigo y a: The main model talks with you and builds the design. The reviewer is optional: it takes a second look at every circuit and every board proposal before it's applied.
El autoruteo usa FreeRouting, que necesi: Autorouting uses FreeRouting, which needs Java 17 or later. Press **Detect Java** or type the path yourself.
Indica los mínimos de fabricación en mil: Enter the manufacturing minimums in millimetres: track width, clearance, via, drill, and hole. If you leave it off, the option doesn't show up in the chat.
Pulsa **Guardar**. Estos ajustes tienen: Press **Save**. These settings take priority over any `.env` file.
El indicador del modelo pasa a verde y *: The model indicator turns green and **Autoroute** appears among the quick actions. You're ready to go.

Instálalo en pocos minutos: Install it in a few minutes
Hay cuatro formas de instalarlo y todas: There are four ways to install it, and they all give you the same plugin. If you're not sure which to pick, use KiCad's **Plugin and Content Manager**. The scripts are for automating or pinning a version, and the ZIP is for installing it by hand.
Necesitas **KiCad 10**. Ábrelo una vez a: You need **KiCad 10**. Open it once before installing. The first time, KiCad needs an internet connection to download what the plugin requires. Java 17 or later is only needed if you're going to autoroute.
Úsalo desde Cursor u otro cliente MCP: Use it from Cursor or another MCP client
KiCad IA también funciona como servidor: KiCad IA also works as an **MCP** server. That way, Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any compatible client can use the same tools as the chat on the KiCad you have open. In this case the model comes from your client, so you don't need to set one up in Settings.
Las reglas no cambian: cada pieza sale d: The rules don't change: every part comes from your libraries with its footprint, the schematic editor must be closed for writing, and placing or autorouting always shows a proposal first. Autorouting only shows up if you turned it on in Settings. The chat's reviewers don't run here; reviewing is up to your client's model.
El plugin que instala KiCad no trae el s: The plugin KiCad installs doesn't include the MCP server. To use it, you need a copy of the repository with its own Python environment. The chat and the MCP server can run at the same time.

Úsalo en tus proyectos y comparte qué te: Use it in your projects and share what worked for you and what didn't. Every real case helps us improve it.

Sí. KiCad IA es gratis y de código abier: Yes. KiCad IA is free and open source under the MIT license. The only thing that may cost money is the AI service you choose; with Ollama you can run a model on your own computer.
¿Necesito saber programar?: Do I need to know how to code?
No. Lo instalas desde KiCad y lo configu: No. You install it from KiCad and set it up in the Settings window. You only need the terminal if you want to use it as an MCP server or contribute code.
¿Qué versión de KiCad necesito?: Which version of KiCad do I need?
KiCad 10. Ábrelo una vez antes de instal: KiCad 10. Open it once before installing so the `Documents/KiCad/<version>/` folder gets created.
De las bibliotecas que ya tienes configu: From the libraries you already have set up in KiCad. If a part is missing, the chat tells you instead of drawing a made-up symbol.
¿Y si un símbolo no tiene huella?: What if a symbol has no footprint?
No lo agrega sin ella. Busca en tus bibl: It won't add it without one. It looks in your libraries for a footprint with the same pad count and, if there are several options, asks which one you prefer.
No. Si una referencia ya existe con el m: No. If a reference already exists with the same symbol, it keeps its identifier and position. And if it's already on the board, the chat doesn't redo the sheet.
Sí, en tu equipo y por proyecto; otro pr: Yes, on your computer and per project; other projects can't see them. The chat uses them as a memory of what you've already decided, but it doesn't reopen them or undo changes. Your API key isn't stored in them.
Porque KiCad 10 todavía no permite escri: Because KiCad 10 doesn't yet allow writing the schematic through its API. The plugin edits the `.kicad_sch` file directly, saving a copy in `<project>-backups/kicad-ia/` first. If the editor is open, it doesn't write, so it won't overwrite your changes.
¿El chat actualiza la placa por su cuent: Does the chat update the board on its own?
No. Cuando el esquemático esté listo, pu: No. When the schematic is ready, press F8 in the PCB editor (Tools → Update PCB from Schematic).
No. Lo activas en Ajustes, con Java 17 o: No. You turn it on in Settings, with Java 17 or later and your manufacturer's minimums. Even then, every proposal waits for your confirmation.
No. Hace una revisión previa con criteri: No. It runs a preliminary check against IPC Class 2 criteria, but it doesn't replace your review or your manufacturer's. When validating, it only fixes what it can fix safely.
